title: Misconceit
summary: MISCONCE'IT MISCONCE'IVE, verb transitive or i. To receive a false notion or opinion of any thing; to misjudge; to have an erroneous understanding of any thing. To yield to others just and reasonable

inlines.v: MISCONCE'IT MISCONCE'IVE, verb transitive or i. To receive a false notion or opinion of any thing; to misjudge; to have an erroneous understanding of any thing. To yield to others just and reasonable causes of those things, which, for want of due consideration heretofore, they have misconceived.
